Instrument.name: Microsoft Surface Pro 5
Instrument.description:
Surface Pro (5th Gen) is a versatile 12.3-inch PixelSense touchscreen 2-in-1 that works as a laptop, tablet, or studio device using its adjustable Kickstand. It offers 7th Gen Intel Core m3, i5, or i7 processors with up to 16 GB RAM and up to 1 TB SSD, making it suitable for everyday productivity and creative tasks. The 3:2 high-resolution display supports precise touch and pen input, while features like stereo speakers with Dolby Audio, front and rear 1080p cameras, and an infrared Windows Hello camera support both media and secure sign-in. Connectivity includes Wi-Fi, Bluetooth, and ports like USB 3.0, Mini DisplayPort, microSDXC, and Surface Connect, with some models also offering LTE Advanced for mobile data, all in a lightweight, highly portable design.
This is a "multi-instance" and "multi-host" instrument, meaning not a specific instrument but rather a type or model of instrument that may be used many times across one or more missions and is not associated with any specific host. Each of these instruments are functionally identical, although they may have instance-specific calibration information.
